reasoning: The question asks whether DOGE will cut more than $250 billion in federal spending in 2025, measured by Q4 2024 vs Q4 2025 federal government current expenditures per FRED data. Multiple credible sources (CBO, WSJ, TechDirt) report that federal spending actually INCREASED by $220 billion in fiscal 2025, not decreased. DOGE's claimed savings ($214 billion, later $206 billion) are disputed as inflated through double-counting and accounting tricks. The only actual spending reductions came from unrelated factors (FDIC, SBA). Elon Musk departed DOGE in late May 2025. The evidence overwhelmingly indicates DOGE failed to achieve spending cuts, let alone $250 billion in reductions. The resolution criteria requires a decrease (Q4 2024 value minus Q4 2025 value) of more than $250 billion, but actual data shows spending increased instead.
